description: List the cards already saved on the account: brand, last four digits, expiry, and which one is the default. Use when the user asks what is on file, or before a top-up so you can name the card — 'the Visa ending 4242' — rather than guessing. Read-only and free. Cards are added by the user in the dashboard, never here; this reads what is already there and returns no card number and no secret.
name: list_payment_methods
